votes.quote: d. mcquaid, motion to support the warrant article, second, m. allison, discussion ensued. n. lockwood had no problem with the article going for town vote, but felt there were pluses and minuses to both sides. k. chenis noted interested parties were in attendance at the last meeting stating they had challenges with selling the property due to the current commercial zoning restricting a dual use of the property. n. lockwood opined that limited business zoning is "messier and less by -right" than commercial zoning. he also noted points previously raised by both the board of selectmen and the property owner noting hardship. roll call vote - m. allison, aye; k. chenis, aye; d. mcquaid, aye; n. lockwood, abstain.
